n: Dispute or award between related parties resolved quickly without contest
ds: A claim, arbitration or judgment is brought between parties that are linked by ownership, control, address or advisers, and it ends in a consent order, uncontested default or quick award with immediate payment.
fp: Group companies, family firms and joint ventures genuinely settle intra-group disputes, and early settlement is common. Check for a real commercial history and whether other group entities are also paid.
